goal: Evaluate whether bounded offline detectors can reproduce useful human/manual L4 annotation labels well enough to justify later runtime research.

evaluation.reason: D1-A/B establishes a reproducible baseline; it must expose errors rather than tune the fixture to pass a target.
evaluation.relational_cases: not scored as text-local labels; deterministic text-local baseline should abstain

guardrails: Detector output is candidate annotation evidence, not truth.
No detector output is automatically written to R1 during D1 evaluation.
No runtime turn hook in D1-A/B.
No prompt injection or response rewrite.
Synthetic benchmark performance is not ecological validity.
Interaction labels requiring antecedent/context are not inferred from isolated text in the baseline.
next: D1-C may evaluate one bounded offline local-model detector against the same benchmark and a small private curated non-synthetic set.
